package.description: An image and photo editing software for PCs that run Windows.

en-US.description: An image and photo editing software for PCs that run Windows.
en-US.longDescription: Paint.NET is an image and photo editing software for PCs that run Windows. It features an intuitive and innovative user interface with support for layers, unlimited undo, special effects, and a wide variety of useful and powerful tools. An active and growing online community provides friendly help, tutorials, and plugins.
en-US.name: paint.net
